name: Media Bulk Download (Lite)
author: Mohamad Shukry

sections.description:
Media Bulk Download lets you quickly select and download multiple media files (images, PDFs, audio, etc.) from the WordPress Media Library.

Whether you’re migrating files, sending assets to clients, or creating backups — this tool saves time and simplifies your workflow.

🎁 Free (Lite) version includes:
– Select up to 10 media files and download them as a ZIP
– Supports both Grid View and List View in the Media Library
– Lite usage limits:
– 5 ZIP downloads per day
– 2-minute cooldown between downloads

🚀 Upgrade to Pro for:
– Unlimited file selection per ZIP
– Unlimited downloads per day
– Priority updates and support
– Clean admin interface with enhanced features

Learn more: https://pluginnests.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP file via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to Media → Library (List or Grid view)
  4. Select multiple items and click “Download as ZIP”
sections.faq:
Can I select more than 10 files?

Only in the Pro version. The Lite version allows up to 10 files per download.

Why do I see a cooldown or daily limit?

To keep the plugin lightweight and fair, the Lite version allows 5 downloads per day and adds a 2-minute cooldown between ZIPs.

Does it work with PDFs, audio, and other files?

Yes, it supports any media file uploaded through WordPress.
